# Riftbound Decklists

> Fan archive of Riftbound TCG Standard tournament decklists, legend hubs, and current-meta strategy.

Riftbound is Riot Games' League of Legends trading card game. This site is not affiliated with Riot Games or UVS Games. The identity card is a Legend.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://riftbounddecklists.com/): Latest public Standard lists
- [Legends](https://riftbounddecklists.com/decklists/): Every legend with public lists
- [Legend strategy](https://riftbounddecklists.com/guides/legend-strategy.html): Current-meta plans by legend
- [Tier list](https://riftbounddecklists.com/tier-list.html): Vendetta Standard picture board
- [Format](https://riftbounddecklists.com/format.html): Standard deck construction
- [Events](https://riftbounddecklists.com/events.html): 2026 organized play digest
- [Guides](https://riftbounddecklists.com/guides/): Topics, domains, and character pages
- [Search](https://riftbounddecklists.com/search.html): Site search
- [Sitemap](https://riftbounddecklists.com/sitemap.xml)

## Optional

- Tournament lists are republished from public results for commentary.
- Shop and price pages use Amazon and TCGplayer affiliate links.
